page_title: ATA 2-1 ROM | Atalanta v AS Roma 12/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Marco Guida is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.

90+3' Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) is afforded space inside the box after collecting a pass, but the chance is wasted as his shot goes harmlessly over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AS Roma.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
88' Substitution. Aleksey Miranchuk (Atalanta) has come on for Ederson.
86' Rasmus Kristensen comes off the pitch to be replaced by Joao Costa (AS Roma).
86' Tammy Abraham (AS Roma) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
86' Daniele De Rossi has decided to make a change. Sardar Azmoun (AS Roma) replaces Bryan Cristante.
86' Tammy Abraham (AS Roma) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
85' Atalanta have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
85' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Atalanta.

83' Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) anticipates the lofted pass and races into the box with just the keeper to beat. He shoots early low towards the middle of the goal, but Marco Carnesecchi pulls off a great save to deny him.
79' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Atalanta.
75' The referee signals a substitution. Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) is brought on as a substitute for Mario Pasalic.
75' Marten de Roon (Atalanta) tackles a bit over-zealously and Marco Guida blows for a foul. AS Roma have a free kick.
73' Tammy Abraham (AS Roma) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out.
71' Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) is flagged for offside.
66' 2 - 1 Goal! Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Marco Carnesecchi into the bottom left corner.
66' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
64' Marco Guida blows the whistle, Marten de Roon (Atalanta) is penalised for a foul. A penalty is awarded to AS Roma!
64' What a big chance! Tammy Abraham (AS Roma) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball just over the crossbar.
63' Marten de Roon (Atalanta) latches onto a lofted pass on the edge of the penalty box and unleashes a volley towards goal, but it goes high over the crossbar.
63' Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.

63' Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the roof of the net. Mile Svilar guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save. The ball is out of play and Atalanta manage to earn a corner.

58' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) was quite harsh and Marco Guida didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card. Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) will miss the next game.

58' Fine attempt! Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) collects a pass and manages to hold off the defender, then rifles in a shot from mid-range which unluckily swerves inches past the left post. The ball goes out of play and AS Roma will have a goal kick.
58' The substitution has been made. Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) has replaced Matteo Ruggeri.
58' Gian Piero Gasperini decides to make a substitution. Gianluca Scamacca will be replaced by El Bilal Toure (Atalanta).
58' The manager makes a subsitution with Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) coming on for Charles De Ketelaere.
57' Tammy Abraham (AS Roma) fouls an opponent during an attacking move. Atalanta win a free kick.
53' Edoardo Bove (AS Roma) picks up a short pass and immediately fires a shot towards the middle of the goal from distance, but Marco Carnesecchi hardly has to move and makes a very easy save.
52' The ball is laid off to Ederson (Atalanta) on the edge of the box. He shoots through a crowd of players towards the bottom right corner and forces Mile Svilar to make a decent save.
51' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle. It's a free kick to Atalanta, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
50' Marco Guida blows his whistle and it's Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee. A free kick to AS Roma.
47' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Atalanta.
46' Evan Ndicka (AS Roma) commits a foul after bringing down his opponent with a slide tackle. Evan Ndicka (AS Roma) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle. Atalanta are awarded the free kick.
46' The game is over for Leandro Paredes (AS Roma). Edoardo Bove comes on for the second half.
46' Daniele De Rossi has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Tammy Abraham comes on the pitch for Tommaso Baldanzi (AS Roma).
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.

45+1' What a huge chance for Mario Pasalic (Atalanta). He collects a precise pass inside the box and slices a shot that goes a whisker wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and AS Roma will have a goal kick.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.

44' Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) takes the free kick from just outside the box and attempts to convert it into a goal. He hits it magnificently and the keeper must be relieved to see the ball hit the right post and ricochet away.
43' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) brings an opponent down and Marco Guida interrupts the game. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Atalanta.
41' Marten de Roon (Atalanta) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
38' Hans Hateboer (Atalanta) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the bottom right corner. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Mile Svilar makes a comfortable save.
38' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) expertly controls a neat clever pass inside the box, but his effort crashes against the right post! What an opportunity that was!

37' A sweet pass inside the box gives Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) time to measure a shot, but it's slightly mishit and goes just wide of the right post. That really was a great chance! The ball goes out of play and AS Roma will have a goal kick.
36' Isak Hien (Atalanta) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. AS Roma are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
34' This should have been a goal! Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) sends a killer pass into the box, but Marten de Roon can't trick the opposition's defence and loses possession.
33' Atalanta are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
25' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
24' Angelino (AS Roma) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
22' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) latches onto a cross inside the box but fires a poor effort well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atalanta.
21' Isak Hien (Atalanta) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Marco Guida has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. AS Roma have a free kick.
20' 2 - 0 Teun Koopmeiners provides Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a low shot into the middle of the goal.

18' 1 - 0 An amazing individual effort from Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) ends with a strike from inside the penalty area. He sends the ball into the right side of the goal and makes it 1:0. Mile Svilar was helpless.
15' Tommaso Baldanzi (AS Roma) probably handled the ball. Atalanta are awarded a free kick.
12' The linesman raises his flag. Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) is adjudged offside.
9' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Atalanta was in an offside position.
9' Atalanta take a short corner kick.
9' Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. Atalanta have been awarded a corner kick.
6' AS Roma can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

6' Angelino (AS Roma) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it. The ball is out of play. AS Roma will have a chance to score from a corner.

4' Berat Djimsiti (Atalanta) was the quickest one to orientate himself inside the box and leaps to connect with a cross from the corner kick. He produces a fine header, but it flies narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and AS Roma will have a goal kick.
4' Atalanta have a corner.

4' Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick strike towards the right side of the target that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a goal-line clearance. The ball goes out of play. Atalanta are awarded a corner kick.
4' The ball goes out of play and it will be a corner kick.
3' The ball is cleared after Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Atalanta.
2' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! A free kick has been awarded to Atalanta.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
AS Roma will kick the game off.
The referee of today's match will be Marco Guida.
